import sys


def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return

    n, m = data[0], data[1]
    pos = 2

    bit_a = [0] * (n + 2)
    bit_b = [0] * (n + 2)

    answers = []

    for _ in range(m):
        op = data[pos]
        pos += 1

        if op == 3:
            x = data[pos]
            pos += 1

            sum_a = 0
            idx = x
            while idx > 0:
                sum_a += bit_a[idx]
                idx -= idx & -idx

            sum_b = 0
            idx = x
            while idx > 0:
                sum_b += bit_b[idx]
                idx -= idx & -idx

            answers.append(str(x * sum_a + sum_b))

        else:
            i = data[pos]
            v = data[pos + 1]
            pos += 2

            if op == 1:
                left = i
                right = i + v - 1
                if right > n:
                    right = n
                a = -1
                b = v + i
            else:
                left = i - v + 1
                if left < 1:
                    left = 1
                right = i
                a = 1
                b = v - i

            idx = left
            while idx <= n:
                bit_a[idx] += a
                bit_b[idx] += b
                idx += idx & -idx

            idx = right + 1
            while idx <= n:
                bit_a[idx] -= a
                bit_b[idx] -= b
                idx += idx & -idx

    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(answers))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
